text:
Alex P.: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off the routing rollout (canary pool) at 10:30 PT. New metrics dashboard and a couple alert threshold tweaks landed in the infra repo. Would love a quick pre-roll check from SRE and ML infra.
Maria G.: Thanks Alex. Which dashboards changed? Any queries I should run now?
Alex P.: main changes are: 'model-routing-latency', 'prefix-cache-hitrate', and a small rename of the p99 token latency panel. Quick checks:
- load the new dashboard (dash/model-routing) and confirm panels render
- run a sample trace for a canary request and confirm span names look sane
- ensure the alert for routing-error-rate is set to 0.5% (not 0.05%) — that's intentional for canary
Devon H.: on it. Linking the dashboard here: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/model-routing
Devon H.: ran one trace (canary id 3f2c). Span names look fine, KV cache miss rate is higher than expected (~12%) — tagging @Alex P.
Alex P.: thanks. KV miss is expected early during canary warm-up. Watch for sustained >20% for 5m.
Jamal R.: confirm rollback plan: if p50 latency increases >30% or error-rate >1% sustained for 3m, we rollback to v47. Who's owning the rollback if that happens?
Alex P.: Jamal, you'll lead rollback if SRE signals. I'll coordinate with infra to pin to v47 and run the quick warm-up. I expect no infra-level changes but we'll be ready.
Maria G.: quick sanity for alerts — what's the exact PromQL for routing-error-rate so I can test firing locally?
Alex P.: promql snippet (copied from repo):
```
sum(rate(redwood_router_errors_total{env="prod",pool="canary"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(redwood_router_requests_total{env="prod",pool="canary"}[5m]))
```
Threshold: >0.005 (0.5%) for 3m
Maria G.: thanks. I'll run a dry-fire against alertmanager to validate notification routing.
sre-bot: alertmanager: test alert for routing-error-rate sent to #eng-oncall at 10:24:45
Devon H.: dash panels render, traces look good, and I validated the promql returns 0.002 for current sample traffic. Will monitor.
Alex P.: two more small observability notes —
1) trace sampling rate increased for canary from 0.1 -> 0.5 to get better signal. I updated the config in infra/telemetry/canary-sampling.yaml
2) temporary log level bump on the router from INFO -> DEBUG for 15 minutes post-deploy. Will revert automatically.
Jamal R.: noted. If we see noise from debug logs affecting ingestion, ping me and I'll throttle.
Maria G.: I fired a test alert to the pager channel; routing-error-rate notifications look correct. Also validated that dashboard panels time range default is now 15m which matches the canary SLO.
Alex P.: launching now (10:30 PT). I'll post back in 5 and 15.
Devon H.: monitoring 10:30 -> 10:50. Dashboards pinned to the watchlist.
Alex P.: 10:35 update — canary p50 +8%, p95 +12%, error-rate 0.23% stable. KV miss trending down. No action yet.
Jamal R.: continuing watch. If error-rate crosses 1% for 3m, I'll start rollback.
Alex P.: 10:46 update — error-rate spike hit 1.2% for ~90s then dropped. Not sustained. No rollback.
Devon H.: traces show the spike tied to a small spike in seq-length on a subset of requests. ML team notified.
Maria G.: alert thresholds and notification routes validated end-to-end. LGTM from observability side.
Alex P.: thanks team. Rolling forward to remaining pools at 11:15 PT unless anyone objects in next 15m. Will update final rollout note in PR and close the watchlist when fully done.
